0.content:
Kachina of the Children of Echoes calls Mualani her first good friend. They met when Mualani knocked over Kachina's cake and took her Spiritway-surfing to make up for it, on a day when Kachina's training had gone badly. Mualani worries that Kachina believes the unkind things people say about her, so she praises her to everyone and tells her she is already a great warrior. In 5.0, when Kachina's team abandoned her, Mualani left her own team for Kinich to lead and paired with her. Kachina beat her in their final individual match. When Kachina failed to return from the Night Warden Wars, Mualani was the first to volunteer to go into the Night Kingdom after her.

She gave Kachina a big sun hat (later replaced when Saurian fur ruined it) and buys her shiny trinkets; Kachina gave Mualani one of a pair of green gems. She paid Kinich as a "battle advisor" so he would teach Kachina wilderness survival. In the Night Kingdom, when the Lector Comonqui mocked Kachina's weakness, Mualani took her hand and they fought him together. Kachina's voice-overs mention a nerve-racking "test of courage" in a cave that Mualani talked her into.

1.content:
Atea was Mualani's neighbour and one of Natlan's most renowned warriors, famous for throwing hot spring parties for "hot spring buddies" who included the Archon. Years ago an Abyssal monster impaled her; she survived, but the corrosion stayed in her body and she could never again soak in the hot springs. She dug artificial springs so others could enjoy them. On the night Mualani earned her Vision, Atea saved her life and called her "a very brave kid".

In 5.0, when the Abyss attacked again, Atea destroyed a Pylon alone and was badly hurt. The Traveler purged the fresh corrosion, but the old corrosion had gone too deep. At the party the next day, Atea told Mualani she had only days left. Seeing Mualani fight had freed her from her regrets: Mualani could bring the tribe together. She entrusted her talisman for Mavuika to the Traveler and died shortly afterwards. Mualani keeps her promise to drink her milk.

Her parting words were that life is a journey with no turning back, so forge ahead. Mualani later said she had dreamed of Atea, "brave and stern" as ever. In 5.3 Atea's soul fought on in the Night Kingdom alongside other fallen warriors; she chose not to see Mualani again, saying their meeting in a dream was enough, and predicted Mualani would surpass her as a warrior.

2.content:
Umoja ("unity") is the Ancient Name of the People of the Springs that Mualani inherited. Five hundred years ago it belonged to Tupac, remembered as the "Giant" who saved Natlan. After Mualani and Kachina defeated Comonqui in the Night Kingdom, her Name glowed even though she had not brought it. Tupac's spirit declared that she had fully embodied her Wayob's aspirations and would unite the tribes. His memories flooded her, revealing that the plan to save Natlan began during the cataclysm, and that the Pyro Archon then was Mavuika herself.

Mavuika explained that she had not told Mualani her role beforehand so that her commitment would come from her own will. Mavuika has said Mualani and Tupac could not be more different in personality, yet both inherited Umoja, because unity is a state of mind: a willingness to give everything for nation, family and friends. Mualani's own reading is that the heroes of the past, the present and the future fight together. In 5.1 she recited Tupac's oath as the six heroes began the Night Wars.

3.comment: Mualani: The Leisurely Puffer and the Sharky Surfboard
3.content:
The Leisurely Puffer is the watersports shop at the People of the Springs that Mualani runs. It sells swimsuits, floaters, waterskis and her custom surfboards, each in a "lucky" colour or pattern. It began because people copied every piece of gear she modified. It has become a gathering place for watersports fans. Her flagship product is an inflatable swimsuit that turns into a life preserver.

Sharky was a wild freshwater shark that tried to catch her while she surfed and became her racing partner. She fed it dried fish when it won, until one day it swam off toward the sunset and never returned. She designed the Sharky Surfboard in its memory, with stiff fins, a flexible tail and meshed teeth, and had Xilonen make it. It sold widely ("that version can't bite"). She still wonders which is faster, the board or the shark.

4.content: Mualani begs the reclusive priestess Citlali for travel fortunes, fighting her through the door. Citlali gave in only after Mualani brought food and dangled an advance copy of a new Mirage Warriors volume from her clients at the Yae Publishing House. The fortune was to take the right-hand path at a fork. An eruption had created an unmapped fork inside a volcano, and the advice got her party through safely. Since then Mualani calls her the "coolest elder", brings gifts, and keeps knocking, waking Citlali around eleven in the morning. Citlali complains that Mualani breaks her door, owes her Mora and eats her food, but also brings snacks, so she calls it even.

key: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
5.content: In the 5.0 Pilgrimage, Mualani asked whether the Traveler could join (refused, since Contending Fire comes only from battles between Natlanese) and then teamed with Kachina. In the team round they took Fire Towers, beat a team and the legendary Amuru, and rode a Spiritway back just in time. Close in the rankings, they met in the final individual match; Kachina won with a surprise attack. Mualani accepted it and told Atea later it was not too surprising: Kachina had always been strong.

6.comment: Mualani: Rescue from the Night Kingdom
6.content: When Mavuika came out of the Sacred Flame without Kachina, Mualani was furious at the hecklers and volunteered for the rescue with the Traveler and Chasca; Iansan joined them. Mavuika used powder and Kachina's Name to contact her. Kachina said the Abyss was corrupting the Wayob and urged them not to risk themselves; Mualani told her nobody saw her as a burden. They entered through an Abyss-torn rift, found Kachina, cleansed her tribe's Wayob and beat the Abyss Lector Comonqui. Mualani was acknowledged by Umoja. As the rift closed, Mavuika's consciousness pulled them home; she had burned her collection of heroes' keepsakes to do it.

7.comment: Mualani: The Mysterious Island and Nuu
7.content: Legend says the first chief of the People of the Springs reached a mysterious island but gave up its treasure to save his companions. Nuu, Mualani's teacher, could not guarantee the journey. Mualani took the Traveler, Paimon and the Sumeru scholar Viramdra there anyway. Nuu then revealed that he had made it too and kept silent: the hidden tablet text fades, so each finder must choose between public glory and leaving the legend to challenge future guides. Mualani chose silence. She told the boastful guide Koolau that she had found something more precious, two friends she could trust with her life, and took a group photo instead. Nuu gave her his talisman to pass on to her own future student.

8.content: Mualani admires Mavuika because she is the Archon and because she looks "super cool" when she surfs. Mualani once challenged her to a race and will not say who won. Mavuika trusted her with the secret that she had given up her power, and Mualani trusts her completely in return: someone who burned her treasured collection to save one person would never hold back for Natlan. In 5.1 Mavuika's fireball exploded over Mualani's head mid-battle; she thought it was "friggin' cool". Mavuika's voice-over says Mualani's life-risking devotion to Kachina was exactly what Umoja means.

9.content: Mualani jokes that Ajaw says more in a day than Kinich does in a year, and notes that both lose interest equally when she talks horoscopes. Kinich first met Kachina through her, and later found that Mualani's "battle advisor" job was really about mentoring Kachina; he concluded she is "not exactly a pushover". In 5.0 he led her original Pilgrimage team, and in 5.3 she and Kachina won a bet against Ajaw and demanded he pay up.

10.content: Mualani's tribe lives along Toyac Springs. It is a seaside people of guides, cartographers and surfers who soak in hot springs alongside their Koholasaurs and "treat every day like a holiday". Outlanders must first get used to the cooler artificial springs before the natural ones, after visitors were scalded. Elders discuss business only after a long soak with snacks and milk. In 5.0 the tribe was attacked through Abyssal Pylons; Mualani, Chief Amina and the patrols held the line. Its Saurian partners are Koholasaurs, and its people can travel long distances along Spiritways.

11.content:
When the Abyss struck several tribes at once in 5.1, Mualani rushed to defend the Children of Echoes and rescued a trapped caravan with Xilonen and the Traveler. She agreed with Mavuika over Capitano's Gnosis plan and joined Kachina's garrison. When the six heroes and Mavuika began the Night Wars, she recited Tupac's oath and called the power "outright scary". She cleared the Abyss from the People of the Springs, then held the Stadium's outer boundary with Kachina during the final assault, and cheered "We WON!" when Mavuika's flames pierced Gosoythoth.

In 5.3 she was in the Stadium when the Sacred Flame guttered and everyone feared the worst ("No... It can't be..."), until Kachina led the crowd in the eulogy. After victory she told the returning Traveler she could not wait to tell their story to everyone.

12.content: Mualani calls Iansan the pride of the Collective of Plenty and all Natlan, unbeaten in Pilgrimages. She paid for Iansan's training class and never started, after seeing how Kachina looked when she finished it and hearing a voice telling her she belonged in the water. Iansan notes the missed class and admires Mualani's untrained strength. They went into the Night Kingdom together in 5.0.

13.content: In 5.8 Mualani and Chasca signed up as testers at the new Easybreeze Holiday Resort: Mualani to research travel plans "like a guinea pig for future clients", Chasca to scout it for her Qucusaur family. Mualani surfed in with Chasca on the Sharky Surfboard. She recognised Bennett as the customer she had steered toward lake blue, and she spent the holiday with him, the Traveler, Paimon and a bard named Venti. She wanted Xilonen to turn Chasca's Soulsniper into a water gun. When Bennett went into an Abyss-tainted domain, she insisted on going with him, though the air there felt like it was crushing her lungs. At the end she gave the Traveler a souvenir headpiece and they took a group photo. This is now a permanent story quest.

14.comment: Mualani: Spirit Envoy Championship and Mamala (6.5)
14.content: In Linnea's story quest (6.5) Mualani turned up in Nod-Krai with her adult Koholasaurus Mamala to enter the Spirit Envoy Championship. She knew Linnea from the Adventurers' Guild's work in Natlan and calls her "Professor". She asked whether a Koholasaur and a Qucusaur could have babies that both fly and swim, so she could matchmake for Mamala, and met Arataki Itto, whose deputy Shinobu had taken the Flower-Feather Clan's flying trial. In the quarterfinals she fought the Traveler and the young Tepetlisaurus Aguara using feints. Aguara exploited the blind spot on Mamala's eyepatched left side and won; Mualani blamed her own calls, praised Aguara and took Mamala for a treat. She stayed to cheer in later matches and wondered about taking drinks home for Citlali.

15.comment: Mualani: Natlan friends: Xilonen, Ororon, Ifa, Varesa, Mizuki
15.content: Xilonen: Mualani trusts the craftsperson the Archon acknowledges and once blurted that Xilonen could fix even a smashed Ancient Name, then frantically took back the jinx. Ororon: a fellow hero; she listed him among the guests at the Traveler's farewell. Ifa: always happy to join her plans, and she thinks the Saurian vet would make a great coach. Varesa: came to the springs for swimming training with Iansan, read comics on the beach and knows more ancient heroes of the People of the Springs than Mualani does. Yumemizuki Mizuki: a chatty friend of the tribe; Mualani wanted to bring purple floaters to her new Natlan branch.

16.comment: Mualani: After the war: the new Pilgrimage (5.3)
16.content: After the peace, Mualani went fishing with Kachina and Kinich using commemorative Stadium badges as bait. She hoped to "reel in" Lord Xbalanque, the first Pyro Archon, whose apparent return had the tribes talking, so she could say hi. The line hooked two drowning surfers instead, and she rescued them, scolding them for not warming up. She suggested everyone join the new Pilgrimage "to kick back and relax", scored as "a natural sports star" during it, and cheered when Kinich won. At the feast afterwards she led a toast to Mavuika for going toe to toe with Xbalanque, and challenged Citlali to a spar, which Citlali refused.

17.content: Her parents are successful merchants, unnamed in canon, with a trade network across Natlan and foreign partners. They were often away for weeks, so holidays meant big family meals. They told her to explore before committing to the family business and promised to support whatever she chose. They spent the night of the Abyss attack frantic until Atea brought her home. In 5.0 they were away on business again. The family dog loves people, comes to the water with her and can surf; she warns that his propeller-like tail hurts.
